releases.title: Four New Games: StarFall, Rooftop Jam, Doodle Tunes & Glitchline
notes: ☄️ New game — StarFall, by Jertal: a duelling deckbuilder of six rival realms. Play the AI, hotseat, or a friend online.
🥁 New game — Rooftop Jam: put a cartoon band together on a city rooftop at night. Tap performers to start their loops, swap styles, and hunt down 17 secret line-ups.
✏️ New game — Doodle Tunes: draw on lined paper and a playhead sings every line it crosses. Colour picks the instrument, and you can export your tune as audio or video.
🧣 New game — Glitchline: sprint across a pixel city at sunset while a glitch deletes the world behind you. Walljumps, glass, ziplines, and a global Best Distance leaderboard.
🛣️ Busy Byways adds 8 new maps, plus various improvements.
🔪 Hanbun has a refreshed set of shapes: new animals, food, toys, vehicles and places, with some weaker shapes retired.

releases.title: Hedgerows, Settings Everywhere & a Bigger Grid
notes: 🌾 New game — Hedgerows: lay hex tiles of field, forest, village, river and rail to grow a countryside. The seasons change as it grows, and landmarks light up when you complete them.
🔊 A volume slider in nearly every game, in each game's menu and pause screen.
🖥️ Menus and on-screen readouts scale up on 1440p and 4K screens in 13 games, including Volt Rush, Shellshock, Solitaire, Floe Fighters, Rhino Pile-Up and Windward Isles.
🛠️ Fixed games going black or blank after a graphics driver hiccup or waking from sleep — Coldmere, Pippin, Vectordrome, Sandfall, Spectre, Switch Hunter, Shellshock and more.
⚡ Volt Rush online gets a rebuilt lobby with 8 arenas, AI fill-ins and spectating after you crash.
🛣️ Busy Byways adds a global leaderboard and turnable houses.
💥 Shellshock has smarter AI, and rapid clicking no longer fires extra shots.
🌀 Vectordrome: hold W to boost, or try the new Mouse Steer mode (X).
🔪 Hanbun duels change the target piece count every few rounds. Online, you can take back your last cut twice per round.
⏱️ Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe online has a 15-second turn clock. If it runs out, a random move is played for you.
🚢 Battleship online no longer gets stuck with both players waiting on each other after a fast return shot.
🐐 Mountain Goat has a new main menu and a better store layout.
🏜️ Sandfall: fixed a couple of graphical and audio bugs.

releases.title: New Roads, New Scenes & a Cold Opening
notes: 🛣️ New game — Busy Byways: draw the roads that keep a growing city moving, solo or head-to-head online.
🎬 Dub Club adds four scenes to dub: Jackie Brown, The Room, Game of Thrones and The Sopranos.
🎙️ Dub Club now plays the off-mic lines to you between takes, so you hear the other half of the scene.
🎲 Dicero is now Pippin, rebuilt by its developer, with the launcher's stats and achievements refitted.
🏔️ Coldmere opens with a hand-drawn cinematic, and its CRT filter is now a row of presets instead of a slider.
🖱️ Fixed the camera or gun snapping sideways in Baseline, Spectre, Floe Fighters and Volt Rush while the mouse was captured.
⚡ Volt Rush sectors now open into pits you have to jump.
🏝️ Windward Isles gets a visual pass: new sky, cleaner shoreline foam and stone along the exposed rim.
🏜️ Sandfall's online Versus screen is rebuilt, with each board keeping its own queue and kit beside it.
🌐 Sandfall and Settlers no longer flip you to the opposite role when the online lobby opens.
⛷️ Alien Alps' menus and Scribble Sled's on-screen controls read a lot bigger.
🌀 Vectordrome scores pure distance now — the near-miss bonus is gone.
✨ The NEW and UPDATED badges catch one light sweeping across the window, and Choose Cover got a tidier, art-forward layout.

releases.title: Menus, Mercy & a Much Smaller Download
notes: 💣 Minefield never loses you to a coin flip anymore — if the board forced a guess, the mine quietly moves and the click is safe.
🐍 Serpent gets a proper death: a shock front races down the body, chars each segment and crumbles it off the board.
🖱️ Cursored now scales to any window size, with a new title screen and your best run shown on it.
🛰️ Spectre's guns sound like guns — new 25mm, 40mm and 105mm reports — and its console fits any screen.
🏰 HQ remembers where you left off, tracks your best run by deaths, and adds the Iron Will achievement.
🏔️ Coldmere gains a CRT filter, an in-game leaderboards panel and layout fixes on narrow screens.
⚡ Volt Rush: finish the campaign to unlock New Campaign+ with a gold NG+ badge, plus a quieter engine mix.
🌀 Vectordrome steers a touch slower and only draws a hazard's lethal part when it can actually kill you.
🎯 Switch Hunter's HUD, menus and pause-screen controls reference got a polish pass, with a click pulse on every button.
🚪 Exit Game moved into each game's own menu in Derpy Bird, Backrooms, Coldmere and Cup of Duck — no more floating corner button.
🏆 Achievements that could never unlock, or unlocked invisibly, are fixed in Rhino Pile-Up, Serpent, Checkers, Mountain Goat and Cursored.
🌐 Online wins now count in Chess, Checkers, Connect 4, Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe and Poke Clash, and Connect 4 no longer hands series wins to the loser.
🏅 New global achievement: Top Ten, for landing in the top 10 of any leaderboard. Near-black profile emblems now get a light halo.
💾 Your stats and achievements are crash-safe with an automatic backup, and the installer is about 110 MB smaller.

releases.title: Leaderboards Everywhere & Card Polish
notes: 🏅 Global leaderboards for five more games — Serpent, 2048, Derpy Bird, Void Assault and Switch Hunter all post to online boards now.
🐍 Serpent's board tracks all four difficulties separately, so a Viper run doesn't compete with a Seedling one.
🏆 A new Leaderboards filter lists every game that has a board, and opens straight to it.
📥 The Imported filter now ends in an Import a Game tile, so adding your own HTML game is always one click away.
🏷️ NEW and UPDATED badges moved to the card's bottom-left with a glyph and a slow sheen, and clearing them all now plays a sweep animation.
🖼️ Right-click a game to switch between its cover variants without opening the cover editor.
🎨 Leaderboard tabs, filter chips and card tag rows all got a readability and contrast pass.
⚡ Volt Rush gained a full ending sequence with its own score, plus new synth effects across the hub and finale.
🎵 Vectordrome got a reworked soundtrack engine and a leaderboard laid out alongside the title menu.
🏔️ Coldmere's renderer is substantially faster — cached trig and packed pixel writes cut the per-frame cost.
🌊 Windward Isles bakes ambient occlusion into the town, so buildings sit in real shade.
🃏 Solitaire Card Parlor got smarter stuck-detection, chain scoring and a completed-run tray.
🐦 Derpy Bird records the bird you were flying when you set a score, and shows the board on the death screen.
🔧 Fixes across Baseline, Cup of Duck, Cursored, Sandfall and Alien Alps, plus redrawn Floe Fighters cover art.

releases.title: Sandfall, Volt Rush & Global Leaderboards
notes: 🏜️ New game — Sandfall: Tetris where the pieces shatter into sand the moment they land — bury a wall-to-wall span of one colour to clear it, and chain the collapses.
🏍️ New game — Volt Rush: carve neon light trails at speed in a free-for-all where every move you make becomes a wall.
🏅 Global leaderboards arrive for seven games — your best now posts to an online board, with a Leaderboard tab on the game's card.
🏷️ NEW and UPDATED badges mark games added or changed since you last played them, with a right-click option to mark everything seen.
🌐 Online play got a netcode overhaul across nine games — rematches, moves arriving mid-animation and mid-match disconnects no longer wedge a game.
🔎 Search now matches tags and developer as well as titles.
🐧 Floe Fighters got a full audio pass: reverb, a master compressor and voice-gating so effects stop piling up on top of each other.
🔧 Various bug fixes and small improvements across Minefield, Serpent, Mountain Goat Climber, 2048, Hanbun Dojo and The Backrooms.
🎨 New Classic cover variants and redrawn art across a dozen games.

releases.title: Vectordrome, Grid Sorting & Crash-Proof Playtime
notes: 🔺 New game — Vectordrome: hurtle down an endless neon cylinder, sliding around the wall to thread gates, blades and lasers to a procedural techno beat.
↕️ New Sort control beside the search bar — order the grid by release, name, playtime, achievements earned or recently updated, and flip the direction.
⏱️ Playtime now banks every 30 seconds while you play, so a crash, shutdown or closed launcher no longer loses the session.
🚀 Void Assault: a big overhaul — ability evolutions, enemy types that unlock as the run goes on, a Void Collapse at 600 seconds, and three new achievements.
✈️ Spectre: campaign intro and finale cinematics, and the aim cursor now grabs itself back after Esc, alt-tab or losing focus.
🎙️ Dub Club: preset scenes get their own shelf, plus timeline wheel-zoom, loudness normalisation and a library band for grabbing more presets.
🏆 Shellshock and Scribble Sled now play a one-time victory cinematic the first time you finish the campaign.
🐐 Mountain Goat Climber: coin pickup animation, trails and particles that stay anchored to the mountain, and a proper tumble out of frame before the score card.
🏯 Hanbun Dojo now fills with earned keepsakes — daruma, maneki-neko, paper crane, bonsai, kabuto and more.
⏸️ Settlers and Floe Fighters got proper pause menus with a quit-to-menu confirm.
🎨 New Classic cover variants for Void Assault, Poke Clash and Mountain Goat Climber, plus redrawn covers across several games.
🗑️ Removing a game now clears its stats for good, and renamed games keep their history instead of starting from zero.
📇 Game cards open on Achievements first, and stats refresh live while the game is still running.
✅ Confirmation popups across the library now put Cancel on the left and the confirm button on the right.

releases.title: Four New Games, Redrawn Covers & a Bigger Alien Alps
notes: 🎙️ New game — Dub Club: talk over a clip on the replay, your voice out of their mouths. Dub the built-in scenes, cut your own, or go online and vote on the best take.
🌊 New game — Samewave: one psychic gives a cryptic clue and the team drags a dial to guess a hidden spot on a spectrum. 4–10 players, couch or online.
✈️ New game — Spectre: sensor operator on an AC-130 gunship, working a gatling, a Bofors and a howitzer through eight night missions.
🛷 New game — Scribble Sled: draw a track in crayon and a sledder rides whatever you scribble. Free-draw sandbox plus eight hand-built challenges.
🏔️ Alien Alps: runs now end on a speed runway into a canyon gap jump, kickers got a real lip for bigger air, and skiers ski the slope — bowl them over.
🎨 Minimalist covers got an art pass — seven games traded placeholder emoji for hand-drawn art.
🖱️ Fixed fullscreen games where the scroll wheel and keyboard did nothing until you clicked.
🌐 The Share panel now has a "Play in your browser" card with its own copy-link button.
🏷️ Two new genre filters: Card Game and Sandbox.
🎬 Hanbun Dojo now opens on a cinematic intro — any key skips it.
🎾 Baseline's interface now scales to your screen, so menus and the scoreboard stop overflowing.
♟️ Chess and Checkers got restyled menus and end-of-game panels.
🔒 Games now run behind a permission allowlist — pointer lock, fullscreen, clipboard and mic only.
💾 New per-game save folders — named saves you can rename, duplicate and export.

releases.title: Three New Games: Hanbun Dojo, Shellshock & Dicero
notes: 🗡️ New game — Hanbun Dojo: play the samurai's blade and split shapes into perfect halves, across ten escalating trials and a nine-round duel (online or hot-seat).
💥 New game — Shellshock: bank-shot tank combat where one hit kills — a 20-mission campaign plus 2–4 player online deathmatch.
🎲 New game — Dicero: a dice-slinging deckbuilder roguelite; chain combos, buy jokers, and climb eight floors of bosses.
🔊 Poke Clash now has sound effects.

releases.title: Fullscreen Play, Exit Buttons & Fresh Covers
notes: 🖥️ Games now launch in fullscreen automatically — every game fills your screen from the moment it opens, no window borders or title bars.
🚪 Every game now has an Exit Game button, styled to match its own menu, with a quick "you sure?" confirmation — your way back to the launcher now that games are fullscreen.
⏸️ Pausing is now standard — Escape and P both pause every real-time game, and games that never had a pause finally got one. Online matches are never frozen mid-game.
🐇 Hero's Quest no longer runs 2–3× too fast on 120Hz/144Hz monitors, and a sweep fixed smaller high-refresh-rate speedups across the other games.
🎨 Coldmere's redesigned cover art now ships with the launcher — new downloads were still getting the old cover.
🔧 Cover art now self-repairs on launch — when a game's cover gets a redesign in an update, it appears automatically, no cover-style swapping needed.
⚡ Smoother library scrolling on lower-powered PCs — the launcher now uses GPU acceleration more reliably and eases off card hover effects while you scroll, fixing stutter some players hit.

🏝️ Windward Isles: buildings now show subtle architectural detail where colors meet — a soft shadow groove settles into the seam between side-by-side walls, and stacked storeys of different colors get a grey stone trim belt along the join.

releases.title: Two New Games & a Coldmere Overhaul
notes: 🏔️ New game: Alien Alps — an alien snowboarding trick-run. Shred five moonlit mountains against a two-minute clock, chaining spins, flips, and rail grinds, beaming cows up to the mothership and dodging skiers all the way down.

🏝️ New game: Windward Isles — a serene island town-builder. Place pastel blocks to grow cozy houses, arches, and little harbors, rotate a day-night sky, snap photos, and autosave as many towns as you like — or open your town online and build it together with friends.

❄️ Coldmere — big update. You can finally escape the manor: floors now ramp from three candles to four to five while the entity grows bolder with every descent, with new Escape and Fastest-Floor stats and fresh achievements to chase.

🎨 Covers load reliably now — cover art refreshes correctly after updates instead of showing stale or blank cards, custom covers that went missing now self-heal, and a fix means newly added covers can always be selected.

releases.title: Two New Games & Reliable Updates
notes: 🖱️ New game: Cursored — a desktop dungeon roguelite where your mouse cursor is the blade. Slash through corrupted icons, grab new weapons from chests, and descend toward the Kernel.

🌀 New game: Switch Hunter — a first-person portal-puzzler across 11 chambers. Fling a teleport ball, warp to where it lands, and hit every switch to escape — while a clawed entity stalks you in the dark.
🔄 Automatic updates are now more reliable — the launcher shows live download progress, surfaces errors instead of hanging silently, and adds a manual "Check for Updates" button in What's New.

🎨 New "Preferred" cover option — switch every game back to its own chosen cover in one click. Default and Minimalist no longer overwrite covers you've customized per game, and your cover choices now stick between launches.
🏷️ Reworked multiplayer tags — games are now labeled Local, Online, Co-op, and PvP in their own section, replacing the old generic Multiplayer / Single Player tags.
🧭 New "Sort by Developer" view — browse the library grouped by creator, ordered by who's made the most games.

releases.title: Baseline & Multiplayer Fixes
notes: 🎾 Baseline: fixed the trophy ceremony where players' caps overlapped their faces.
🌐 Baseline online: the ball no longer disappears at your opponent's end — added opponent hit animations and smoother, predictive paddle movement for cleaner rallies.
🎾 Baseline: fixed never-ending rallies where the ball got stuck going straight back and forth in a corner — shots now angle out of the corner and long rallies speed up until someone misses.
🔍 Online: stale and abandoned rooms now clear out of the room browser, so you only see matches you can actually join.
🔴 Connect 4 online: you now see your opponent's live cursor hovering above the column they're considering.

🏷️ Online multiplayer: your real account name now shows up in-game and in the room browser across Connect 4, Chess, Checkers, Battleship, Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe, Poké Clash and Rhino Pileup — no more generic "Player 1" / "Player 2".
⚔️ Black Knight: fixed downloading for players who installed it before the new update system — your copy now refreshes to the latest version automatically.

releases.title: Baseline, Feedback & Polish
notes: 🆕 New game: Baseline — serve, rally, and outlast your opponent in this tennis arcade experience.
💬 Added a Feedback button so you can send notes and bug reports without leaving the launcher.
🔗 Added a Share button to show off your favorite games.
⚡ Big performance improvements to the launcher — faster load times and smoother navigation.
🙏 Added credits for third-party developers whose work powers several games.
🎨 Refreshed cover art for Rhino Pileup, Floe Fighters, and Coldmere.
🐛 Fixed a Void Assault softlock that could freeze your run if you had unlocked every upgrade.

releases.title: Black Knight Updates
notes: 💾 Black Knight: your run now saves automatically — close the game any time and pick up right where you left off with the new "Continue Run" button.
📖 Black Knight: the Bestiary now reveals each foe only after you've faced it, so there's something to uncover as you descend.
🎨 Black Knight: fresh cover art.
✅ Black Knight is out of work-in-progress and ready to play.
🌐 Fixed online multiplayer lobby search so open rooms show up reliably when browsing.
🐛 Squashed assorted bugs across several games for smoother, more stable play.

releases.title: Three New Games & Better Multiplayer
notes: 🎲 New game: Settlers — build, trade, and settle your way to victory with up to 6 players online.
🦆 New game: Cup of Duck — a four-level platformer where a determined mallard climbs, double-jumps, and glides toward a refreshing cup of berry water.
🧊 New game: Floe Fighters — fast-paced online multiplayer action on the ice.
🌐 Improved online multiplayer: smoother lobbies and solid support for games with 3 or more players.
✨ Various visual polish across the launcher.

releases.title: What's New & a Tidier Launcher
notes: ✨ Added a "What's New" button to the top bar so you can read release notes right in the launcher.
📜 What's New now opens to the latest update, with a "See all patch notes" button to browse the full history.
🔔 A gold dot appears on the button whenever a new update has notes you haven't seen yet.
🧹 Updates are now leaner — builds no longer include dev, test, or backup files, or personal save data.

releases.title: Pickle Arcade Launch
notes: 🎮 First public release of Pickle Arcade.
🕹️ Full game library with covers, stats, and achievements.
🏆 Player profiles, favorites, and a recently-played row.
🔄 Auto-updates: the launcher now checks for new versions on startup.
